stage: Stage 2: post-pilot internal validation; every Bao curve is development-exposed
frozen_campaign: One complete matrix; report every arm; no adaptation to outer scores; stop after audit and replay
source: Same 320 eligible Bao formulations, raw pinned files and cleaning retained from pilot
external_confirmation: None. Neither reused outer folds nor another potentially overlapping literature compilation is called untouched
prefix: First 3 valid distinct-time records, often time zero plus 2 positive-time records; suffix observed times are query inputs

outer.assignment: sorted joint drug/publication components, NumPy default_rng shuffle, round robin

inner.assignment: same component rule within each outer training set, seed_base + outer_fold

groups: Connected components sharing exact SMILES or MW/TPSA/LogP rounded 6 digits OR official publication DOI; 78 components
metric: Mean formulation-level mean absolute suffix error in percentage points; no whole-curve or row-weighted headline
training_weights: Each training formulation has total row weight 1; rescale mean weight to 1 for regularization consistency
preprocessing: Training-split median imputation and one-hot method encoding, fitted separately in every inner fold and outer refit
candidate_selection: Fit first two prefix records, score third absolute error. Common fits and pool for all summaries. Refit predictions on all 3 visible records. Pareto minimizes error and declared parameter count with exact original ranking.py
bounded_kinetics: KP log-linear positive t/y fit, exponent bounded [0.1,2], k [1e-6,10]. Weibull log-log fit for t>0 and 0<y<1, beta [0.1,3], alpha days [1e-3,1e4]. At least 2 usable points required; otherwise prefix-only first-order fallback. Recompute intercept after bounded exponent. All forecasts clipped [0,1]. No nonlinear optimizer or full-curve fitted parameter is used
identifiability: Two positive records only identify 2 transformed parameters with no residual degrees of freedom. R2 is descriptive fit quality, never evidence of mechanism. Retain fit-count and fallback flags

arms.name: kin_all
arms.features: raw + common kinetic parameters + mean/std/count of ALL 6 candidate forecasts

arms.name: kin_min
arms.features: raw + common kinetic parameters + minimum-prefix-error forecast/zero std/count=1; stable pool-order tie break

arms.name: kin_pareto
arms.features: raw + common kinetic parameters + Pareto-front forecast mean/std/count

arms.name: kin_all_pareto
arms.features: raw + common kinetic parameters + all-candidate mean/std/count + Pareto mean/std/count

arms.name: kin_all_pareto_residual
arms.target: observed release minus first-order prefix-only forecast; add anchor at prediction, clip [0,1]

config_budget: Exactly 4 predeclared configurations per learner per arm, 3 inner folds; all fits retained, no early stopping, same grids in direct/residual and all feature arms
selection: Lowest pooled inner out-of-fold formulation MAE; fixed grid index breaks ties; outer labels never used for configuration selection
uncertainty: 5000 joint-component paired percentile bootstrap draws conditional on this exposed corpus and fitted nested procedure; Holm family correction across all 10 two-sided centered-bootstrap p-values; descriptive internal evidence only
invariance: Every eligible formulation: future-label perturbation must preserve all features, candidate selection and forecasts; visible-prefix perturbation positive control; held-out models refit only on training profiles
replay: Repeat the entire frozen nested matrix in fresh processes; compare predictions, inner scores, chosen configurations and receipts byte for byte
prior_art_scope: Alabsi public model card supplies KP/Weibull and LightGBM motivation but does not establish prefix-only fitting; this is a safely reimplemented inspired comparator, not an exact reproduction. MC-NODE publisher pages were unavailable; no numerical cross-paper superiority claim or pickle loading
scientific_limit: Retrospective digitized in-vitro PLGA, no external or prospective validation, no lab/clinical/savings claims, no full evolutionary optimizer
